scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of zero multiplicities, fold regularity and topological density; finite high-precision checks are supplementary only. All originality conclusions remain subject to independent priority review.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the discontinuous two-step Haar waveform and real narrowband Doppler zeros on strictly overlapping delays. The countable-dense fold set is not an explicit enumeration or a finite-band claim. Classical overlap formulas and general ambiguity principles are prior work. An obscure equivalent treatment may exist in two-frequency exponential-polynomial or radar waveform literature.
title: Countable dense delay folds and a cubic resonance in the Haar ambiguity function
